name: octosuite
description: OctoSuite: OctoBrowser.su (privacy-focused browser) and OctoDetect.su (privacy audit tool) for Windows 10/11

scripts.dist:browser: npm run icons && npm run build:browser && electron-builder --win --x64 --projectDir apps/octobrowser
scripts.dist:detect: npm run icons && npm run build:detect && electron-builder --win --x64 --projectDir apps/octodetect
scripts.dist:dir: npm run icons && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --dir --projectDir apps/octobrowser && electron-builder --win --x64 --dir --projectDir apps/octodetect
scripts.dist: npm run dist:browser && npm run dist:detect
scripts.release: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run dist && npm run installer && npm run sign-manifest
scripts.e2e: npm run build && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts
